title: Transformer model stratifies axial elongation risk in orthokeratology lens wearers
summary: A transformer-based Hierarchical Attention Model (HAM) was trained on 1,639 myopia patients (3,271 eyes) from Peking University People's Hospital using routine eye examinations and questionnaires. On the training set precision was 0.852 and recall 0.853, with an AUC of 0.98 for high-risk patients; in temporal validation on 216 patients (356 eyes) collected at different times, precision was 85.33%, recall 75.12% and F1 79.90%. The abstract says it outperformed nine other models; validation is from the same hospital.
